text:
Lena: Quick check — can we slide next release train cutoff by one working day? EU holiday makes tomorrow thin for reviews.
Jon: +1 from infra side if it helps unblock QA. What day are you thinking?
Lena: Move cutoff from Thu to Fri (so extra 24h), keep train on normal Mon deploy.
Asha: That would overlap with my planned post-freeze feature merge. If we move cutoff, I need a branch window to merge two small fixes.
Lena: Understood — propose this plan:
- Cutoff new PRs at 11:59pm Thu -> shifted to 11:59pm Fri
- Cherry-pick queue open Fri 08:00-12:00 for emergency fixes only
- Shiproom on Mon same time
Jon: Sounds reasonable. Will update the release calendar and the binary-build job.
Priya: FYI QA team is low on capacity Fri afternoon. If we shift, please tag anything that must go through full regression with `regress/required`.
Lena: Good point. We'll call out `regress/required`. Also, @ReleaseBot can you nudge the change log owners about version bump?
ReleaseBot: Auto-note: Requested changelog bump for train v2026.04 by Lena. Owners: @Connor, @Priya.
Connor: I'll take changelog draft, can update by Fri 10:00. Can someone ping me with any highlights?
Asha: I'll drop two bullets in #docs with the API change and the rollback note.
Jon: Ops action: updating the branch protection cutoff in repo-config. Patch diff:```yaml
release_cutoff: '2026-04-10T23:59:00Z'
cherry_pick_window: '2026-04-11T08:00:00Z to 2026-04-11T12:00:00Z'
```
Jon: CI job name `release-train-build` will also get a skip-if-holiday flag set.
Lena: Nice. Two quick asks: 1) someone watch the cherry-pick queue Fri morning? 2) Priya, can QA do a quick smoke on Fri 11:30?
Priya: I can cover 11:30-12:00 smoke, but not full regression. I'll coordinate with QA rota.
Connor: I'll monitor the changelog PR and ping as needed.
Asha: I'll label the feature merges with `post-freeze-awaiting` so we can identify any stragglers.
Lena: Thanks all. I'll update the release calendar event and the shared checklist. If anyone sees blockers overnight, drop them here or DM me. :thumbsup:
